protocol.precision: Matches prior driving evaluation: float32 high matmul
protocol.averaging: Equal episode means. Stability excludes terminal/collision target frames; exclude episode/scope with <5 samples. Jerk is control-rate finite difference of projected longitudinal acceleration; no smoothing/filtering.
protocol.scope: One training seed. New evaluation is the first20-map subset of earlier100-map tests; do not add as independent episodes. Policy alters subsequent traffic interactions.
protocol.common_prefix: Per scenario all models truncated at min(10s, earliest termination), with 1s warmup and endpoint margin.
protocol.speed_bins: 5-15,15-25,25-35 km/h, descriptive speed-stratified diagnostic, not a causal speed-matched experiment.
protocol.example_selection: First seed in each split, fixed before outcomes. Also export every episode example.
